verdict.rationale: Kintsugi's core service is described as autonomous background automation once connected — it syncs transactions continuously, monitors nexus, registers, and files/remits taxes 'on schedule' without further manual intervention (docs-1, docs-25). However, this is a fixed, product-specific automation pipeline (tax sync/filing) rather than a general agentic automation framework a user can configure arbitrary triggers/actions for, and the MCP server explicitly does not execute actions or proxy API calls (docs-30), so it can't be used to build custom autonomous agent workflows. Missing for 10: evidence of a configurable automation/workflow builder, scheduling of arbitrary user-defined tasks, or agent-triggered actions beyond the built-in tax pipeline.
